sources.quality_notes: Publisher-hosted article abstract attributes an earlier Ming-print assertion to named bibliographic received works, cites contrary writings and leaves the issue unresolved ('两说未知孰是'). It distinguishes 1827 Fuli printing and 1869 later revision as the author's discussed chronology. Publisher abstract is visibly truncated mid-sentence. No original physical Ming-print, 1827 or 1869 target page, or full 1959 article is authenticated. The 2019 Du Xuelin article is already registered under EXT-PKU-CHINESE-CLASSICS-CULTURE-DU2019-YEHUOBIAN-MING-PRINT-QUESTION; do not re-register or double-count. This is a secondary scholarly position only.
